# GREENPLASTWOOD (SNG Eco India Pvt. Ltd.)

> Indian manufacturer of Wood Polymer Composite (WPC) building products — chaukhats (door frames), window frames, doors (plain, texture, digital print and prelaminated; solid and 3 layer), WPC/PVC sheets & boards, PVC panels and recycled plastic sheets. Company founded 2012, Greenplastwood brand since 2017, head office in Ahmedabad, 3 manufacturing plants near Morbi, Gujarat.

## Key facts
- Legal name: SNG Eco India Pvt. Ltd. (since 2012); brand: GREENPLASTWOOD (since 2017, 9 years of WPC manufacturing)
- Corporate office: 1312, 1313, 1314, 13th Floor, Fortune Business Hub, Nr. Shell Petrol Pump, Science City Road, Sola, Ahmedabad – 380060, Gujarat, India
- Email: sales.executive11@sngecoindia.com; phone: +91 90163 36119
- 3 manufacturing plants near Morbi, Gujarat (Unit 1 and Unit 2: Hirapar; Unit 3: Village Gala); production capacity about 1,300 MT a month; factory area 105,000 sq ft; team 125+
- 300+ projects, 50+ major stock points, exports to 4+ countries, 9+ certifications
- Trusted by 150+ companies and 200+ business associates, across corporates, government departments, schools, builders and architects in India
- ISO 9001:2015 (QMS, scope: manufacturer and supplier of WPC and PVC products); Udyam MSME UDYAM-GJ-01-0302769; Importer-Exporter Code; IGBC membership (2024)
- Lab tests (Alekh Plastics Testing Centre, Nov 2022): water absorption 0.2%; UL-94 V-0; door frame density 0.90 g/cc, screw withdrawal 2236 N; door & board density 0.66 g/cc, compressive strength 65 MPa, flexural strength 23 MPa
- Customers include Adani, IFFCO, Indian Oil, Intas, KRIBHCO, MP Public Works Department, Skipper, Ramky Group, Podar Education Network
- WPC products are 100% water proof, termite & borer proof, fire retardant, formaldehyde & lead free and recyclable

## Products
- [WPC Door Frames](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-door-frames.html): Single Rebate Frame Size: 75 × 50 mm · 100 × 50 mm · 100 × 63 mm · 125 × 63 mm · 150 × 63 mm 60 × 30 mm · 65 × 40 mm · 90 × 45 mm · 90 × 63 mm; Double Rebate Frame Size: 120 × 50 mm · 125 × 63 mm · 150 × 63 mm; Window Frame: 70 × 30 mm · 120 × 50 mm; Profile Models: Mould & Groove · Mould & Plain · Square Model; Length: 7 ft, 8 ft, 9 ft, 10 ft Size can be customised on bulk orders.; Density: 750 kg/m³ to 1200 kg/m³; Colours: Light Ivory, Yellow Ivory, Pure White, Beach White, Teak Wood, Chocolate Brown, Coco Brown, Black NFC colour can be customised on bulk orders.; Warranty: 30 Years*
- [WPC Window Frames](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-window-frames.html): Window Frame Size: 70 × 30 mm · 120 × 50 mm; Length: 7 ft, 8 ft, 9 ft, 10 ft Size can be customised on bulk orders.; Density: 750 kg/m³ to 1200 kg/m³; Colours: Light Ivory, Yellow Ivory, Pure White, Beach White, Teak Wood, Chocolate Brown, Coco Brown, Black NFC colour can be customised on bulk orders.; Material: Wood Polymer Composite (WPC)
- [WPC Solid Doors](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-solid-doors.html): Thickness: 17, 18, 24, 25, 28, 30, 32, 35 mm, etc.; Standard Size: 27 × 78, 30 × 81, 33 × 84, 36 × 81, 38 × 84 (inches); Density: 550 kg/m³, customised as per order up to 750 kg/m³; Available Colour: Ivory is the regular colour. Other colours (White, Grey, Brown, Sephia, Teakwood): MOQ 300 doors.; Finishes: Plain with carving · Colour · Laminate · Texture · Digital print; Customisation: Thickness, width, length and density customised on bulk orders.
- [WPC 3 Layer Doors](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-solid-doors.html#type-3-layer): Thickness: 24, 25, 28, 30, 32, 35 mm, etc.; Standard Size: 27 × 78, 30 × 81, 33 × 84, 36 × 81, 38 × 84 (inches); Density: 600 kg/m³, customised as per order up to 750 kg/m³; Outer Layers: 0.8 mm to 1 mm rigid PVC, density 1400 kg/m³; Available Colour: Ivory is the regular colour. Other colours (White, Yellow, Brown): MOQ 300 doors.; Customisation: Thickness, width, length and density customised on bulk orders.
- [WPC / PVC Boards & Sheets](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-boards-sheets.html): Thickness: 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 17, 18 mm, etc.; Standard Size: 8 ft × 4 ft Size can be customised on big orders.; Density: 450 kg/m³ to 600 kg/m³, customised as per order up to 750 kg/m³; Available Colour: White, Red, Ivory, Orange, Coco Brown, Dark Grey, Yellow, Blue, Green MOQ: 100 sheets per colour and thickness.; Customisation: Thickness, length and density customised on bulk orders.
- [WPC 3 Layer Boards](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-boards-sheets.html#type-3-layer): Thickness: 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 17, 18 mm, etc.; Standard Size: 8 ft × 4 ft Size can be customised on big orders.; Density: 550 kg/m³ to 600 kg/m³, customised as per order up to 750 kg/m³; Available Colour: White (standard), Ivory, Brown, WPC Bulk order: 9 tons or more.; Customisation: Thickness, length and density customised on bulk orders.
- [PVC Panel](https://sngecoindia.com/product-wpc-louvers.html): Series: 12 mm 2G (200 Series) · 15 mm 8G (300 Series) · 24 mm (100 Series); Panel Size: 200 mm × 2900 mm (12 mm) · 165 mm × 2900 mm (15 mm and 24 mm); Thickness: 12 mm, 15 mm, 24 mm; Designs: 63 designs: 21 in each series (wood, marble, stone and solid finishes); Exterior PVC panels: 215 × 26 mm (Brown), 215 × 25 mm (Teak, Grey) · 8 ft and 10 ft lengths; Uses: wall paneling, ceiling paneling, exterior paneling; Properties: 100% water & moisture resistant, termite proof, stain resistant, low maintenance
- [Recycled Plastic Sheet](https://sngecoindia.com/product-recycled-plastic-sheet.html): recycled plastic solid sheets by SNG Eco India (since 2012); brick pallets 16–50 mm (600 × 600 to 950 × 750 mm), paver block pallets 8 and 12 mm (up to 1220 × 1220 mm); density 1.30 g/cm³, water absorption 0.25%, no swelling after 72 hrs boiling; also used in place of shuttering ply; buy back at 20%
